title: Gut Microbiome Analysis in Mice Using Illumina Sequencing
author: Trina Knotts
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ynpfvdn

steps.title: Prepare Mice for Collection
steps.instruction: House mice singly in clean cages with fresh food, water, and low bedding.

steps.title: Initial Weighing and Diet Sampling
steps.instruction: Record initial weights and preserve diet samples.

substeps.instruction: Weigh the 'food-in' (grams of rodent diet provided at the start of the experiment).
Save several pellets of rodent diet for analysis (e.g., energy or macronutrient content) and store at 4°C in an airtight container.

steps.title: Intermediate and Final Weighing
steps.instruction: Monitor mouse and food weights at specific intervals.

substeps.instruction: At 24h, weigh the mouse and the 'food-out' (grams of rodent diet remaining).
At the end of the 48h collection period, weigh the mouse and the 'food-out'.

steps.title: Cage Maintenance and Animal Return
steps.instruction: Reset the housing environment for the animals.

substeps.instruction: Swap out cage bottoms with new clean bottoms.
Replace feeder insert and water bottle.
Return animals to the housing system.

steps.title: Collect Fecal Samples
steps.instruction: Carefully extract and clean feces from the cage bedding.

substeps.instruction: Inspect and remove each piece of bedding using tweezers to collect all feces.
Inspect each fecal pellet to ensure no spilled food, hair fibers, or bedding are attached.
If significant food spillage is found in the cage bottom, weigh it in a pre-tared weigh boat to add back to food measurements.

steps.title: Determine Fecal Wet Weight
steps.instruction: Measure the weight of the collected feces.

substeps.instruction: Place feces in a labeled, pre-weighed 1.5 ml tube.
Subtract the original tube weight from the final weight to determine fecal 'wet' weight.

steps.title: Store and Ship Samples
steps.instruction: Preserve samples and transport them for sequencing.

substeps.instruction: Store fecal samples at -80°C until analysis.

Ship/deliver samples on dry ice to UCDavis MBP (Mouse Biology Program C/O UC Davis MMPC, University of California, 2795 Second Street, Suite 400, Davis, CA 95618; 530-757-3333) for 16S DNA amplicon sequencing and analysis.
Include the MBP/MMPC project # in the reference section of package documentation.
Send the FedEx/UPS tracking number to mmpc-bodyc@ucdavis.edu.
